findings.text: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/history.spec.ts` was not run. It is the capability check of CAP-dm-history (AC-dm-30, AC-dm-31, AC-dm-48 in the browser) and depends on the frontend lane files (src/api/historyApi.ts, src/features/history/*, CompanyPage, ResultPage, App.tsx) and on tests/e2e/history.spec.ts, none of which belong to this unit. It is deferred integration evidence.

`pnpm test -- <files>` runs the whole vitest suite: pnpm forwards the literal `--` and vitest treats it as the end of options, so the file filter is dropped. The unit's Done-when command therefore ran 12 files / 600 tests (all passed, exit 0). The two unit files alone also pass (`pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/compareDiagnoses.test.ts tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts`: 34 tests, exit 0).

The unit could not add server/repositories/historyRepository.ts (not in the allowed files). The two queries the diagnosis repository lacks (list a company's diagnoses with draft and archived; set/clear archivedAt guarded by the opposite state) live in `createHistoryData` at the top of server/services/historyService.ts, separated from the rules, so they can move to a repository file unchanged. `findPrevious` and `toCalculator` in historyService.ts mirror the private helpers of diagnosisService.ts (same ordering: completedAt desc, same instant → larger id is older) because those are not exported and that file belongs to phase-1-backend-diagnoses.

evidence.text: AC-dm-30 (backend half): timeline with draft progress (completedBlocks of totalBlocks), completed entries with stage / rulesVersion / confidence, archived list apart, archive and restore keeping answers and result, first diagnosis with canCompare=false and comparison refused with 409 no_previous_diagnosis; covered in tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts. AC-dm-31 (backend half): stage before → after, per-dimension before/after/delta, risks resolved and new, recalculation of the previous with the current rules and original score kept; covered in tests/unit/compareDiagnoses.test.ts (rulesV2 fixture) and tests/api/historyRoutes.test.ts (second app session with rulesV2; stored v1 result untouched).

messages.text: IF-005 as implemented. GET /api/companies/:id/timeline -> { draft: { id, currentBlock, completedBlocks, totalBlocks (8), createdAt, updatedAt } | null, completed: TimelineEntry[], archived: TimelineEntry[] } (newest first; `draft` is null, not absent, when there is none). TimelineEntry = { id, companyId, completedAt, archivedAt (null while active), stage, rulesVersion, confidence ('high'|'medium'|'low'), canCompare } - canCompare is false for the first diagnosis (BR-dm-08) and whenever no earlier non-archived completed diagnosis exists, so show 'Comparar' only when it is true. Unknown company -> 404 company_not_found.

POST /api/diagnoses/:id/archive and /restore answer with the updated TimelineEntry (not a DiagnosisView, which has no archivedAt); both are idempotent. Draft -> 409 diagnosis_not_completed; unknown id -> 404 diagnosis_not_found. GET /api/diagnoses/:id/comparison -> DiagnosisComparison from shared/domain/compareDiagnoses.ts: { previous: {id, completedAt, stage, rulesVersion}, current: {...}, stageChange: {from, to, direction 'up'|'down'|'same'}, average: {before, after, delta} (mean of the 8 scores, rounded), dimensions: [{key, before, after, delta}] in DIMENSION_KEYS order, risksResolved: RiskResult[], risksNew: RiskResult[], recalculated?: { fromVersion, toVersion, originalScore: { stage, average } } }. Draft -> 409 diagnosis_not_completed; no earlier non-archived completed diagnosis -> 409 no_previous_diagnosis. When `recalculated` is present, previous.stage / previous.rulesVersion and the dimension 'before' values are the recalculated ones (the number that counts); originalScore is what it said when concluded. IF-005 only named `originalScore`; it is an object { stage, average } because the prototype notice needs both ('estágio N, média M').

Recalculation uses the app's current rules (deps.rules in createApp) only when previous.result.rulesVersion differs from current.result.rulesVersion. If the app ever holds three or more rules versions, a diagnosis frozen with an intermediate version will be compared against rules newer than its own; that needs a registry of historical Rules by version, which does not exist yet (only rulesV1 ships). Not a problem with v1 + the v2 test fixture.

Run the deferred capability checks after the frontend lane lands: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/history.spec.ts` (second diagnosis from the first, comparison with arrow + text, archive/restore confirming and cancelling with the ConfirmDialog, no comparison offered for the first diagnosis), then the full `pnpm test` and `pnpm test:e2e`. Note `pnpm test -- <files>` ignores the file filter (literal `--`); use `pnpm exec vitest run <files>` for a focused run. server/app.ts is also edited by the CAP-dm-report unit later in this phase: this unit only added the historyRoutes mount and hoisted `const rules = deps.rules ?? rulesV1` shared by the diagnosis and history services.
